label: final-vintage pseudo-real-time back-test: each forecast uses only values dated (and, for inputs, published) up to its origin, but read from today's table versions; never real-time skill
disclaimer: Research forecast for evaluation only: not investment advice, not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any asset, not a trading signal. Exchange rates, bond yields and oil prices are close to unpredictable beyond a random walk; every REVA finance forecast is scored against one.
tests: Diebold-Mariano with HLN correction, one-sided, Holm step-down per model and benchmark across (family, horizon) cells at 0.05; primary metric CRPS (levels) / Brier (meetings); a candidate wins a cell only if significantly better than every benchmark scored on it
